name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-02-09, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
